FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Everard stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle shift is underway. The king, resplendent in his ornate armor, strides through the courtyard, his gaze fixed on the horizon.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard sits upon his throne, his advisors gathered around him. The air is thick with the scent of old parchment and burning incense.

KING EVERARD
( stroking his beard )
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our empire. One that blends the grandeur of our past with the... (he searches for the right word)...the futurism of the unknown.

ADVISOR 1
(nervously)
Your Majesty, are you certain this is wise? The people may not understand...

KING EVERARD
(interrupting)
Silence! I have seen the future, and it is... (he pauses, a faraway look in his eyes)...it is a realm of misty dawns and neon-lit nights.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The king's advisors are seen wandering the castle grounds, taking in the sights and sounds of the changing aesthetic. They pause before a fountain, where water flows from a series of glowing, jellyfish-like orbs.

ADVISOR 2
(whispering)
What sorcery is this, Your Majesty?

KING EVERARD
(smiling)
It is the essence of our new era. The fusion of ancient and modern, of mysticism and technology.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors are now seated before a large, ornate mirror. The mirror's surface ripples and distorts, like the surface of a pond on a summer's day.

KING EVERARD
( gesturing to the mirror )
Behold! The reflection of our empire's soul. A realm of... (he searches for the right word)...of wistful longing and retrofuturistic dreams.

ADVISOR 3
(awed)
It is... it is beautiful, Your Majesty.

KING EVERARD
(nodding)
Yes. And it is only the beginning. For in this new era, we will not only rule with an iron fist, but also with a... (he pauses, a sly smile spreading across his face)...a velvet-gloved fist.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal landscape of neon lights, misty dawns, and ancient stone. The people move through the streets, their faces aglow with a mixture of wonder and unease.

KING EVERARD
(standing atop a hill, surveying his domain)
This is our new empire. A realm of... (he pauses, a faraway look in his eyes)...of vaporwave dreams and medieval grandeur.

FADE TO BLACK.
